excerpt: Table 3 lists study design features for a mindfulness-based intervention: teacher information such as retreat attendance, contemplative instruction experience, clinical qualifications, and blinding; practice information such as setting, duration, meeting frequency, practice types, practice logs, and instructional materials; general information such as adherence assessment, control group, randomization method, and adverse events monitored; participant information such as inclusion/exclusion criteria and prior meditation experience; and conflicts of interest.
overview: This checklist is a concrete methodological artifact. It translates the authors' criticism into a prescriptive reporting and design standard, making clear that intervention efficacy cannot be interpreted without knowing teacher qualifications, practice dose, controls, participant selection, and safety monitoring.
title: MBI Design Checklist
